mainText: Good morning. Markets are open today for a half day session, closing early at 1 p m Eastern. Futures are sharply higher after Wednesday's wild session. The Nasdaq is up two point two percent, the S and P 500 is up one point six percent, and the Dow is up one point three percent, on a strong rebound in A I and chip stocks. The 10 year Treasury yield is four point nine two percent, up about six basis points from Wednesday's close. Biggest premarket movers: SanDisk up ten point four percent on a memory chip rebound, Nebius up nine point five percent, CoreWeave up seven point nine percent, Marvell up six point five percent after beating quarterly expectations, and Vertex down seven point five percent after the F D A extended its review of a kidney disease drug by up to three months.
